name: Guide Robot
summary: Qingbao’s Guide Robot is a humanlike service robot for guided visits, reception and question answering in cultural, educational and public-service settings. The official range includes female A1F and male A1M bodies with Basic, Standard and Flagship configurations. Basic versions use a fixed body, while Standard and Flagship versions include an intelligent mobile base for autonomous touring and reception.
